subject: Urgent: Medisphere production errors & latency in us-east-1a — immediate failover requested
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medisphere.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Production: spike in 5xx and token latency (us-east-1a)

Ben / Monica —

We're seeing a sudden spike in 5xx errors and token-level latency for our traffic that routes to us-east-1a. Error rate jumped from ~0.3% to 9% over the last 18 minutes; median generation p95 jumped from 180ms to 1.2s and some requests are timing out. Our users are seeing real impact on checkout flows.

Attached a small error snippet and a short CSV of recent metrics. We urgently need Redwood to fail over Medisphere traffic to another region (us-west-2) while you investigate — we cannot have degraded throughput. Please confirm immediate steps and an ETA.

Tom and I are on standby: Alicia G.

Attachments: error_snippet.log, redwood_metrics_2026-10-16.csv

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medisphere.com>, Tom Bradley <t.bradley@medisphere.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 14:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Production: spike in 5xx and token latency (us-east-1a)

Alicia — thank you for the heads up and for the attachments. I'm escalating this now to our infra team and ops. Short answers up front: we can execute an emergency cross-region steer to us-west-2 within ~15-25 minutes, but I need ops to confirm capacity and any downstream cache/warming implications.

Immediate asks for your side so we can triage faster:
- sample request-id(s) for any recent 5xx responses (X-Request-Id header)
- confirmation of whether you want a full region failover or traffic-shift-by-percentage (we recommend 100% for immediate impact)

I'm looping in David (infra) and Hannah (SRE liaison) for a runbook execution. Monica/Stephanie: can you please open a HubSpot incident and set priority P0? I'll follow up to confirm the steer once Ops acknowledges.

On standby — Ben

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -04:00
Subject: [Exec Escalation] Medisphere — urgent failover approval and runbook (us-east-1a)

Team — customer Medisphere reporting a rapid jump in 5xx and token latency (see attached CSV). Customer requests immediate failover to us-west-2. This needs exec attention and a coordinated operation.

Symptom summary (customer-supplied + preliminary telemetry):
- Error rate ~9% (was ~0.3% 30m ago)
- P95 token generation latency 1.2s (normal ~180ms)
- Throughput drop on us-east-1a pools; retries amplify QPS briefly

Proposed immediate plan (we can refine):
1) Ops: cordon the suspect AZ worker pool in us-east-1a to stop new placement
2) Activate "failover-urgent" routing policy for the Medisphere route (route id: medisphere-prod) to prefer us-west-2 model variants
3) Drain in-flight KV cache gracefully; enable prefix-warm to minimize cold-start regen costs
4) Notify customer when traffic switch is complete and monitor error-rate/latency for 30m

Risks: short-term bump in median latency due to cold caches and model-warm, potential token billing differences, and brief increase in 429s as we adjust batching.

David/Hannah: please confirm ETA for steps 1–3. Monica/Stephanie: ensure HubSpot and the customer success playbook are active; recommend an exec bridge in 10m. Marissa: flag for leadership awareness (this is a top-$ account).

Thanks — Ben

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 14:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: [Exec Escalation] Medisphere — urgent failover approval and runbook (us-east-1a)

Ben / Team — quick diagnostics and actions taken:

Findings (quick):
- Root cause signal looks like hardware-side IO scheduling contention on a subset of the us-east-1a G5 pools hosting medisphere-prod. OS-level IO stalls correlate with large KV cache evictions and a pattern of small large-batch requests from the customer ramp.
- Affected worker subset: us-east-1a-pool-7 (approx 12% of customer capacity)

Immediate actions executed (14:28–14:33):
- cordoned us-east-1a-pool-7 from scheduler (no new placement)
- activated routing policy failover-urgent for medisphere-prod; started gradual steering (0 -> 50% -> 100%) to us-west-2 as we validate
- kicked cache-prefix-warmers in us-west-2 to reduce cold-starts

ETA / impact:
- We expect the switch to complete to 100% by ~14:45 ET. During the warm period expect a short 150–300ms median latency uplift for ~10–15 minutes while models warm KV caches. Error rate should drop under 1% as we finish steering.

Attachments: runbook-failover-steps.md, klog-urn.txt

I will keep this thread updated every 10 minutes and post metrics to the incident dashboard. If leadership wants to pause the final 100% steer, advise now.

-David
David Kim
Infrastructure — Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medisphere.com>, Tom Bradley <t.bradley@medisphere.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Production: spike in 5xx and token latency (us-east-1a)

Alicia / Tom — update and next steps: thanks for the quick signal. We completed an emergency steer of Medisphere production traffic off us-east-1a to us-west-2 at 14:44 ET. Current observations:

- Error rate reduced from ~9% to 0.6% within 7 minutes of the final steer
- P95 latency is back to ~220ms after warmers completed (temporary 200–300ms bump during warm)
- No customer-visible data loss; traffic continuity preserved during the operation

Immediate customer commitments:
- We will run a short post-incident review with you and our infra leads tomorrow at 10:00 PT; Marissa will join for exec-level review.
- As an apology for the outage window, we will issue a one-week service credit against your October usage (HubSpot ticket updated).
- We're opening Jira RUN-9876 for the root-cause investigation; I'll share the draft postmortem early next week with remediation timelines.

Attachments: redwood_metrics_2026-10-16.csv (customer-sent), runbook-failover-steps.md (ops)

If you can share any additional X-Request-Id headers or logs from your side it will help with the RCA. We're standing by for any questions — Ben
